moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio cam-roll, written here): Hit accent: the whole frame rotates 0 -> 0.9 deg in 60 ms and back to 0 by 300 ms ease-out (easeOutCubic). Demo exaggerates it as a continuous roll of +-4.6 deg (0.08 rad) on a 3 s sine. Params: angle (0.9°) · attack (60 ms) · decay (0.24 s). Call it once per hit. The demo exaggerates the angle (2.5°) so the roll reads on a small preview, as the site's demo does.
